verdict.rationale: Three.js is fundamentally a browser WebGL/WebGPU library requiring a GPU-backed rendering context; the evidence pack contains no mention of headless rendering, Node.js server-side use, headless-gl/puppeteer integration, or CI automation support. This is a fair question for a rendering engine (other engines in this space document headless CI paths), so absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
